title: 灰姑娘
description: 經典童話，灰姑娘的奇幻故事

sentences.en: Once upon a time, there lived a beautiful girl named Cinderella.
sentences.zh: 從前，有一個美麗的女孩叫仙杜瑞拉。

sentences.en: Her stepmother was very cruel to her.
Cinderella had to do all the housework.
sentences.zh: 仙杜瑞拉必須做所有的家務。

sentences.en: One day, an invitation came to the palace.
sentences.zh: 一天，一張邀請函送到了皇宮。

sentences.en: The stepmother wouldn't let Cinderella go.
A fairy godmother appeared with magic.
sentences.zh: 一位仙女教母帶著魔法出現了。

sentences.en: She turned a pumpkin into a golden carriage.
sentences.zh: 她把南瓜變成了金色馬車。

sentences.en: Cinderella wore a beautiful glass shoe.
sentences.zh: 仙杜瑞拉穿著美麗的玻璃鞋。

sentences.en: At the ball, she met the prince.
sentences.zh: 在舞會上，她遇到了王子。

sentences.en: The prince found the glass shoe.
sentences.zh: 王子找到了那只玻璃鞋。

sentences.en: He searched for the girl who fit the shoe.
sentences.zh: 他尋找適合這雙鞋的女孩。

sentences.en: They got married and lived happily ever after.
sentences.zh: 他們結婚了，從此過著幸福的生活。
